integrity: The complete proof is analytic; finite numerical checks are supplementary, and priority comparisons distinguish unit-ball results from the nonball theorem.
scientific_limitations: The results apply to monomial-circle polynomials on nonball complex ellipsoids, not arbitrary stable polynomials.
The critical exponent 3/2 is previously known in the unit-ball case; the exact nonball approximation constants and normalized capacity are the distinctive statements.
Capacity uses the stated coefficient-kernel normalization; no uniformity is asserted as geometric or weight parameters vary.
Earlier unindexed adaptations of diagonal-unitary averaging could overlap with the exact formulas.
title: Exact cyclicity, polynomial-ideal distances and boundary capacity for monomial circles on complex ellipsoids
